feeds.title: World Kabaddi
feeds.description: World Kabaddi was formed on 24th March 2018 and currently has more than 52 members and is rapidly growing on all 5 continents. Kabaddi originated in India some 5,000 years ago. It is one of the select traditional sports that has grown into a mainstream sport. The organization hopes to double its membership by 2020 with special attention to promoting the game outside the Asian region. World Kabaddi is registered in the UK and its headquarters and secretariat are based in Kuala Lumpur. In November 2020, World Kabaddi received its affiliation from The Association For International Sports for All.
